★ Request
Fade in from black
No plastic bag
Machikane Tannhauser stands up from bottom (with a nosebleed)

Really? Seems pretty normal to me.
Though hearing you say I look full of energy makes me happy. Ehehe♪

Just as she said, she showed no signs of fatigue, mentally or physically.
If anything, she looked livelier and more energetic than usual.

Yeah, happens all the time.
I'm totally fine~. ...*snort-sniffle*.

Now that I think about it, short of something extreme happening,
she's almost always cheerful and energetic.

...Huh, weird? Where'd I put them?
O~ver here, little octopuses, come on out~. O~cto~puse~s――

Fuku-chan-senpai said this fact hasn't gone public yet,
so we're the only ones who know about it.

Oh yeah, Trainer, do you want some octopus gummies too?
I still have a bunch left.
On top of that, she got a nosebleed from the impact of hitting the table...!

――Ah! But the bagged octopuses!
I'm sorry, I'll save you right now~~~...oof!

I chewed carefully on that scallop mantle... pondering life
as I immersed myself in the profound flavors~.

Besides, that was quite a jam-packed schedule for a single day.
Most people would be completely exhausted, but...
Ow-w-w, I bessed up. ...*sniff*.
(Clatter-scatter-crash!!)

Huh? I'm not tired at all~. Everything was right around the neighborhood,
so I'm totally peppy! See, look how light on my feet I am!

While I was wrapping up some work before training,
Machikane Tannhauser walked in in high spirits.

Ehehe♪ So that's how I enjoyed some octopuses, scallops,
and the Eighth Lucky God~.

Fuku-chan-senpai and I were so moved by such a legendary presence...!
We said our prayers and enjoyed every bite~♪

Man, an auntie from the shopping district happened to pass by and brewed us tea,
and boy did it go amazingly with the scallop mantle!

After that, it was non-stop octopus snacking! And after persevering,
we found two whole crab gummies and happily shared them♪
Whoaaa?!

When we looked closely at the package, the octopus speech bubble said,
"Contains ultra-rare crab gummies!"――

Plus, Nature was super sweet.
She even let me have the very last precious piece!

...I couldn't quite make sense of it,
so I decided to ask for the full story.
And we got our hands on the rainbow octopus gummies! But!
(CLUNK!!)

Yup, yup! Rainbow octopuses, scallop mantles,
and um, let's see~... the Eighth Lucky God, Tokoroten!!
...Sounds like her day was way more eventful than I thought.
Hyaaaah?!

We finally found it!
Standing alongside Daikokuten and Ebisu――the Eighth Lucky God, Tokoroten!

Machikane Tannhauser crashed into the table,
spilling the bag of gummies all over the floor...!

Lastly, fortune hunting with Fuku-chan-senpai! Over hills and across mountains,
and where we finally arrived, we saw――

Then next, after buying dried scallop mantle with Nature at the shopping district~,
it was munch-munch tea time!

First of all~, Turbo said she wanted rainbow octopus gummies,
so we went to the convenience store together!

She was so cheerful and lively it almost made me worry sometimes.
I resolved once again to keep watching over her as best as I could.
Man~, I'm really, really glad to have such great friends.
Super, super satisfied~! Hehehe~♪
